features: Instant camera launch on startup with CameraX lifecycle
Hardware-accelerated low latency H.264 (AVC Baseline) encoder via MediaCodec
OMT (Open Media Transport) UDP packetizer with sequence numbers & microsecond PTS
RFC 6184 RTP packetizer with single NAL and FU-A fragmentation
Real-time HUD with live FPS, bitrate, packet count, and estimated latency
Front/Back camera flipping, flashlight torch toggle, and audio microphone capture
Settings sheet for destination IP, port, stream ID, and encoding presets

compatibility.desktopOmt: Compatible with standard OMT receivers, OBS Studio, vMix, and FFmpeg/GStreamer
